versos.hebraico: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֣יִם לֶב־מֶ֭לֶךְ בְּיַד־יְהוָ֑ה עַֽל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֖ר יַחְפֹּ֣ץ יַטֶּֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: The king’s heart is in Yahweh’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.
controles.kjv: The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
controles.livre: Como ribeiros de águas é o coração do rei na mão do SENHOR, ele o conduz para onde quer.

versos.hebraico: כָּֽל־דֶּרֶךְ־אִ֭ישׁ יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but Yahweh weighs the hearts.
controles.kjv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the Lord pondereth the hearts.
controles.livre: Todo caminho do homem é correto aos seus próprios olhos; mas o SENHOR pesa os corações.

versos.hebraico: עֲ֭שֹׂה צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נִבְחָ֖ר לַיהוָ֣ה מִזָּֽבַח׃

controles.web: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
controles.kjv: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.
controles.livre: Praticar justiça e juízo é mais aceitável ao SENHOR do que sacrifício.

versos.hebraico: רוּם־עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַב־לֵ֑ב נִ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃

controles.web: A high look, and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.
controles.kjv: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
controles.livre: Olhos orgulhosos e coração arrogante: a lavoura dos perversos é pecado.

versos.hebraico: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת חָ֭רוּץ אַךְ־לְמוֹתָ֑ר וְכָל־אָ֝֗ץ אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃

controles.web: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.
controles.kjv: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
controles.livre: Os planos de quem trabalha com empenho somente levam à abundância; mas os de todo apressado somente à pobreza.

versos.hebraico: פֹּ֣עַל א֭וֹצָרוֹת בִּלְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר הֶ֥בֶל נִ֝דָּ֗ף מְבַקְשֵׁי־מָֽוֶת׃

controles.web: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
controles.kjv: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
controles.livre: Trabalhar para obter tesouros com língua mentirosa é algo inútil e fácil de se perder; os que assim fazem buscam a morte.

versos.hebraico: שֹׁד־רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְגוֹרֵ֑ם כִּ֥י מֵ֝אֲנ֗וּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.
controles.kjv: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
controles.livre: A violência praticada pelos perversos os destruirá, porque se negam a fazer o que é justo.

versos.hebraico: הֲפַכְפַּ֬ךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ אִ֣ישׁ וָזָ֑ר וְ֝זַ֗ךְ יָשָׁ֥ר פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.
controles.kjv: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
controles.livre: O caminho do homem transgressor é problemático; porém a obra do puro é correta.

versos.hebraico: ט֗וֹב לָשֶׁ֥בֶת עַל־פִּנַּת־גָּ֑ג מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים וּבֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר׃

controles.web: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than to share a house with a contentious woman.
controles.kjv: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
controles.livre: É melhor morar num canto do terraço do que numa casa espaçosa com uma mulher briguenta.

versos.hebraico: נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָ֭שָׁע אִוְּתָה־רָ֑ע לֹא־יֻחַ֖ן בְּעֵינָ֣יו רֵעֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.
controles.kjv: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
controles.livre: A alma do perverso deseja o mal; seu próximo não lhe agrada em seus olhos.

versos.hebraico: בַּעְנָשׁ־לֵ֭ץ יֶחְכַּם־פֶּ֑תִי וּבְהַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ֝חָכָ֗ם יִקַּח־דָּֽעַת׃

controles.web: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
controles.kjv: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
controles.livre: Castigando ao zombador, o ingênuo se torna sábio; e ensinando ao sábio, ele ganha conhecimento.

versos.hebraico: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל צַ֭דִּיק לְבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע מְסַלֵּ֖ף רְשָׁעִ֣ים לָרָֽע׃

controles.web: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
controles.kjv: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
controles.livre: O justo considera prudentemente a casa do perverso; ele transtorna os perversos para a ruína.

versos.hebraico: אֹטֵ֣ם אָ֭זְנוֹ מִזַּעֲקַת־דָּ֑ל גַּֽם־ה֥וּא יִ֝קְרָ֗א וְלֹ֣א יֵעָנֶֽה׃

controles.web: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.
controles.kjv: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
controles.livre: Quem tapa seu ouvido ao clamor do pobre, ele também clamará, mas não será ouvido.

versos.hebraico: מַתָּ֣ן בַּ֭סֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה־אָ֑ף וְשֹׁ֥חַד בַּ֝חֵ֗ק חֵמָ֥ה עַזָּֽה׃

controles.web: A gift in secret pacifies anger; and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.
controles.kjv: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
controles.livre: O presente em segredo extingue a ira; e a dádiva no colo acalma o forte furor.

versos.hebraico: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַ֭צַּדִּיק עֲשׂ֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

controles.web: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
controles.kjv: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
controles.livre: Alegria para o justo é fazer justiça; mas isso é pavor para os que praticam maldade.

versos.hebraico: אָדָ֗ם תּ֭וֹעֶה מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל בִּקְהַ֖ל רְפָאִ֣ים יָנֽוּחַ׃

controles.web: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.
controles.kjv: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
controles.livre: O homem que se afasta do caminho do entendimento repousará no ajuntamento dos mortos.

versos.hebraico: אִ֣ישׁ מַ֭חְסוֹר אֹהֵ֣ב שִׂמְחָ֑ה אֹהֵ֥ב יַֽיִן־וָ֝שֶׁ֗מֶן לֹ֣א יַעֲשִֽׁיר׃

controles.web: He who loves pleasure shall be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil shall not be rich.
controles.kjv: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
controles.livre: Quem ama o prazer sofrerá necessidade; aquele que ama o vinho e o azeite nunca enriquecerá.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֣פֶר לַצַּדִּ֣יק רָשָׁ֑ע וְתַ֖חַת יְשָׁרִ֣ים בּוֹגֵֽד׃

controles.web: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous; the treacherous for the upright.
controles.kjv: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
controles.livre: O resgate em troca do justo é o perverso; e no lugar do reto fica o transgressor.

versos.hebraico: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת בְּאֶֽרֶץ־מִדְבָּ֑ר מֵאֵ֖שֶׁת מדונים וָכָֽעַס׃

controles.web: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.
controles.kjv: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
controles.livre: É melhor morar em terra deserta do que com uma mulher briguenta e que se irrita facilmente.

versos.hebraico: אוֹצָ֤ר׀ נֶחְמָ֣ד וָ֭שֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וּכְסִ֖יל אָדָ֣ם יְבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man swallows it up.
controles.kjv: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
controles.livre: Há tesouro desejável e azeite na casa do sábio; mas o homem tolo é devorador.

versos.hebraico: רֹ֭דֵף צְדָקָ֣ה וָחָ֑סֶד יִמְצָ֥א חַ֝יִּ֗ים צְדָקָ֥ה וְכָבֽוֹד׃

controles.web: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
controles.kjv: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
controles.livre: Quem segue a justiça e a bondade achará vida, justiça e honra.

versos.hebraico: עִ֣יר גִּ֭בֹּרִים עָלָ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗רֶד עֹ֣ז מִבְטֶחָֽה׃

controles.web: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
controles.kjv: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
controles.livre: O sábio passa por cima da cidade dos fortes e derruba a fortaleza em que confiam.

versos.hebraico: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו וּלְשׁוֹנ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֖ר מִצָּר֣וֹת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

controles.web: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.
controles.kjv: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
controles.livre: Quem guarda sua boca e sua língua guarda sua alma de angústias.

versos.hebraico: זֵ֣ד יָ֭הִיר לֵ֣ץ שְׁמ֑וֹ ע֝וֹשֶׂ֗ה בְּעֶבְרַ֥ת זָדֽוֹן׃

controles.web: The proud and haughty man, “scoffer” is his name; he works in the arrogance of pride.
controles.kjv: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
controles.livre: “Zombador” é o nome do arrogante e orgulhoso; ele trata os outros com uma arrogância irritante.

versos.hebraico: תַּאֲוַ֣ת עָצֵ֣ל תְּמִיתֶ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־מֵאֲנ֖וּ יָדָ֣יו לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

controles.web: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.
controles.kjv: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
controles.livre: O desejo do preguiçoso o matará, porque suas mãos se recusam a trabalhar;

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם הִתְאַוָּ֣ה תַאֲוָ֑ה וְצַדִּ֥יק יִ֝תֵּ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃

controles.web: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
controles.kjv: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
controles.livre: Ele fica desejando suas cobiças o dia todo; mas o justo dá, e não deixa de dar.

versos.hebraico: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־בְזִמָּ֥ה יְבִיאֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination: how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!
controles.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
controles.livre: O sacrifício dos perversos é abominável; quanto mais quando a oferta é feita com má intenção.

versos.hebraico: עֵד־כְּזָבִ֥ים יֹאבֵ֑ד וְאִ֥ישׁ שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗עַ לָנֶ֥צַח יְדַבֵּֽר׃

controles.web: A false witness will perish, and a man who listens speaks to eternity.
controles.kjv: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
controles.livre: A testemunha mentirosa perecerá; porém o homem que ouve a verdade falará com sucesso.

versos.hebraico: הֵעֵ֬ז אִ֣ישׁ רָשָׁ֣ע בְּפָנָ֑יו וְ֝יָשָׁ֗ר ה֤וּא׀ יכין דרכיו׃

controles.web: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.
controles.kjv: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
controles.livre: O homem perverso endurece seu rosto, mas o correto confirma o seu caminho.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣ין חָ֭כְמָה וְאֵ֣ין תְּבוּנָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין עֵ֝צָ֗ה לְנֶ֣גֶד יְהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
controles.kjv: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the Lord.
controles.livre: Não há sabedoria, nem entendimento, nem conselho contra o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: ס֗וּס מ֭וּכָן לְי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְ֝לַֽיהוָ֗ה הַתְּשׁוּעָֽה׃

controles.web: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
controles.kjv: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the Lord.
controles.livre: O cavalo é preparado para o dia da batalha, mas a vitória vem do SENHOR.
